title: Coal India MT CS/IT 2022 — Previous Year Paper

questions.question: Select the correct synonym of 'METICULOUS':
questions.explanation: 'Meticulous' means showing great attention to detail; careful and precise. 'Painstaking' is a synonym.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Accommodation' with double 'c' and double 'm'.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'Neither the manager nor the employees _____ present at the meeting.'
questions.explanation: When subject components are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it ('employees' -> plural -> 'were').
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Select the idiom that best means 'to accept a difficult situation courageously':
options: Burn the candle at both ends
Hit the nail on the head
questions.explanation: 'Bite the bullet' means to face a difficult situation with courage and fortitude.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Identify the antonym for 'CANDID':
questions.explanation: 'Candid' means truthful and straightforward. 'Deceitful' is its direct antonym.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Change into passive voice: 'The committee approved the new coal mining policy.'
options: The new coal mining policy was approved by the committee.
The new coal mining policy is approved by the committee.
The new coal mining policy has been approved by the committee.
The committee had approved the new coal mining policy.
questions.explanation: Simple past active ('approved') changes to 'was approved' in passive voice.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: One-word substitution: 'A person who looks at the bright side of things.'
questions.explanation: An optimist is a person who tends to be hopeful and confident about the future or the success of something.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Identify the error in: 'She is more cleverer than her sister.'
questions.explanation: Double comparatives ('more cleverer') are grammatically incorrect. It should be 'cleverer' or 'more clever'.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'The scientist was awarded for his _____ contribution to renewable energy.'
questions.explanation: 'Exemplary' means serving as a desirable model; outstanding.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Select the correct indirect form: He said, 'I am reading a research paper on AI.'
options: He said that he was reading a research paper on AI.
He said that he is reading a research paper on AI.
He said that I was reading a research paper on AI.
He told that he had been reading a research paper on AI.
questions.explanation: Present continuous ('am reading') becomes past continuous ('was reading') in indirect speech.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Choose the appropriate preposition: 'He is proficient _____ Python programming.'
questions.explanation: The word 'proficient' is followed by the preposition 'in' when referring to a skill or domain.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Select the correct sentence:
options: Each of the candidates have submitted their application.
Each of the candidates has submitted his or her application.
Each of the candidate has submitted their application.
questions.explanation: 'Each of' takes a plural noun ('candidates') followed by a singular verb ('has').
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Select the synonym for 'PRAGMATIC':
questions.explanation: 'Pragmatic' means dealing with things sensibly and realistically; practical.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Choose the correct antonym of 'AMBIGUOUS':
questions.explanation: 'Ambiguous' means open to more than one interpretation. 'Explicit' means clear and stated in detail.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'Hardly had he entered the laboratory _____ the power supply failed.'
questions.explanation: 'Hardly... when' is the correct correlative conjunction pair.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: One-word substitution: 'The study of ancient human societies through physical remains.'
questions.explanation: 'Archaeology' is the study of human activity through the recovery and analysis of material culture.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Find the misspelled word:
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Inheritance' (ending in -ance).
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Meaning of 'Burn the midnight oil':
questions.explanation: 'Burn the midnight oil' means to study or work late into the night.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Identify the segment containing a grammatical error: 'The team of researchers are preparing the report.'
questions.explanation: 'Team' is a collective noun acting as a single unit here, so it requires the singular verb 'is preparing'.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Select the correct phrase to complete: 'In spite _____ heavy rain, the survey was completed.'
questions.explanation: The standard prepositional phrase is 'In spite of'.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Where is the headquarters of Coal India Limited (CIL) situated?
questions.explanation: Coal India Limited (CIL) is headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Coal India Limited functions under which Ministry of the Government of India?
questions.explanation: CIL is a Maharatna PSU under the Ministry of Coal.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which subsidiary of CIL operates predominantly in the Singrauli region across MP and UP?
questions.explanation: Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL) operates in the Singrauli district of MP and UP.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: What status was conferred upon Coal India Limited in 2011?
questions.explanation: CIL was conferred Maharatna status by the Government of India in April 2011.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which type of coal is found in the highest quantity in Indian coal reserves?
questions.explanation: Bituminous coal (non-coking and coking) accounts for the vast majority of Indian coal reserves.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Who was the chief architect of the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution guarantees the Right to Equality before Law?
questions.explanation: Article 14 guarantees equality before law and equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: What is the primary objective of the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan?
questions.explanation: PM Gati Shakti is aimed at integrated planning and coordinated implementation of infrastructure projects across India.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which planet in our solar system is known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.explanation: Mars is known as the Red Planet due to the prevalence of iron oxide on its surface.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: What is the SI unit of electric current?
questions.explanation: Ampere (A) is the SI unit of electric current.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: In the Union Budget of India, the fiscal deficit is defined as:
options: Total expenditure minus total receipts excluding borrowings
questions.explanation: Fiscal Deficit = Total Expenditure − Total Receipts (excluding borrowings).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which Indian city is known as the 'Silicon Valley of India'?
questions.explanation: Bengaluru is recognized as the Silicon Valley of India due to its central role as the nation's leading IT exporter.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which international organization publishes the World Economic Outlook report?
questions.explanation: The World Economic Outlook (WEO) is published semi-annually by the International Monetary Fund (IMF).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which sanctuary in Assam is famous for the one-horned rhinoceros?
questions.explanation: Kaziranga National Park in Assam hosts two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceroses.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for Gold?
questions.explanation: The chemical symbol for Gold is Au (from the Latin 'Aurum').
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Who was the first Indian to win a Nobel Prize?
questions.explanation: Rabindranath Tagore won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913 for his work 'Gitanjali'.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which layer of the atmosphere contains the protective Ozone layer?
questions.explanation: The stratosphere contains the ozone layer, which absorbs solar ultraviolet radiation.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which regulatory body regulates the stock markets in India?
questions.explanation: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) regulates the capital and securities market in India.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: What is the primary function of RAM in a computer system?
options: Volatile high-speed temporary storage for active execution
questions.explanation: Random Access Memory (RAM) provides fast, volatile read/write storage for processes currently executing.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which Indian state has the longest coastline?
questions.explanation: Gujarat has the longest mainland coastline in India (~1,214 km).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: In a relational database, what does ACID stand for?
questions.explanation: ACID properties (Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability) guarantee reliable database transactions.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which SQL command is used to remove a table and all its contents permanently from a schema?
questions.explanation: DROP TABLE deletes the table definition as well as all rows, indexes, and constraints.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the time complexity of searching for an element in a balanced Binary Search Tree (BST)?
questions.explanation: Search, insertion, and deletion in a balanced BST (such as AVL or Red-Black tree) take O(log n) time.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which CPU scheduling algorithm can lead to the 'Convoy Effect'?
questions.explanation: FCFS can cause a Convoy Effect where small processes wait behind a long CPU-bound process.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for end-to-end process-to-process communication?
questions.explanation: The Transport Layer (TCP/UDP) provides process-to-process communication using port numbers.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the default subnet mask for a Class C IP address?
questions.explanation: Class C networks use a 24-bit network prefix, yielding a default mask of 255.255.255.0.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which object-oriented programming concept allows a subclass to provide a specific implementation of a method already defined in its superclass?
questions.explanation: Method Overriding allows a derived class to override a virtual/base method with its own specific logic.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which normal form removes transitive dependencies in relational database design?
questions.explanation: Third Normal Form (3NF) requires a relation to be in 2NF and have no non-key attribute transitively dependent on the primary key.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In process management, what condition occurs when two or more processes are blocked waiting for resources held by each other?
questions.explanation: Deadlock is a state where each process in a set is waiting for a resource that another process in the set holds.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which sorting algorithm relies on the Divide and Conquer strategy and has an average time complexity of O(n log n)?
questions.explanation: Quick Sort partitions arrays recursively using a pivot (Divide & Conquer), achieving average O(n log n).
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the maximum number of nodes in a binary tree of height 'h' (where height of root node is 0)?
questions.explanation: For height h starting at 0, max nodes = 1 + 2 + 4 + ... + 2^h = 2^(h+1) - 1.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which HTTP status code signifies '200 OK'?
questions.explanation: HTTP status code 200 indicates standard success for HTTP requests.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which data structure follows the LIFO (Last In First Out) principle?
questions.explanation: Stack operates on LIFO order for insertion (push) and deletion (pop).
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the function of the ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) in IP networking?
options: Resolves domain names to IP addresses
Resolves IP addresses to MAC (Physical) addresses
questions.explanation: ARP maps 32-bit IPv4 addresses to 48-bit Ethernet MAC addresses within a local network.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which design pattern ensures a class has only one instance and provides a global access point to it?
questions.explanation: Singleton Pattern restricts instantiation of a class to a single object instance.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In C++, what type of member function cannot access non-static class members?
questions.explanation: Static member functions do not possess a 'this' pointer and can only directly access static data members.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which graph traversal technique uses a Queue data structure?
questions.explanation: BFS uses a FIFO queue to visit adjacent vertices level by level.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the result of binary addition: 1011 + 0101?
questions.explanation: 1011 (11 in decimal) + 0101 (5 in decimal) = 10000 (16 in decimal).
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In virtual memory systems, what is 'Thrashing'?
options: A state where the system spends more time paging than executing processes
questions.explanation: Thrashing occurs when memory allocation is inadequate and page fault rates spike, spending most cycles page swapping.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which logic gate outputs HIGH (1) if and only if both of its inputs are HIGH (1)?
questions.explanation: An AND gate gives a 1 output only when both input signals are 1.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the primary role of a Compiler in software development?
options: Translates high-level source code into low-level machine code at once
Links object code with DLL libraries at runtime
questions.explanation: Compilers translate entire high-level program modules into target machine instructions.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In Software Testing, what is Regression Testing?
options: Re-running tests to ensure code modifications haven't broken existing functionality
Testing system limits under heavy stress load
questions.explanation: Regression testing verifies that past software features continue to work as expected after updates.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is a Foreign Key in relational database tables?
options: A key that uniquely identifies a row within its own table
A field in one table that refers to the primary key in another table
A composite key spanning three tables
questions.explanation: A foreign key establishes a link between data in two tables by matching primary key columns.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which of the following is a non-preemptive scheduling algorithm?
questions.explanation: FCFS runs tasks until completion or explicit I/O blocking without preemptive interrupt.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which layer of TCP/IP protocol suite corresponds to OSI Data Link + Physical layers?
questions.explanation: Network Access (Link) layer in TCP/IP maps to OSI Physical and Data Link layers.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which data structure is best suited for implementing a Queue?
options: Singly Linked List with head and tail pointers
questions.explanation: A linked list with head (dequeue) and tail (enqueue) pointers allows O(1) enqueue and dequeue operations.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the main advantage of dynamic programming over simple recursion?
options: Stores solutions to overlapping subproblems to avoid redundant computation
Converts non-linear algorithms into linear ones automatically
questions.explanation: Dynamic programming uses memoization or tabulation to store already solved subproblem results.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In Java, which keyword is used to prevent class inheritance?
questions.explanation: Declaring a class as 'final' prevents it from being extended by any subclass.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which algorithm is used to find the shortest path from a single source vertex to all other vertices in a weighted graph with non-negative edge weights?
questions.explanation: Dijkstra's algorithm computes single-source shortest paths on graphs with non-negative edge weights.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What does DNS stand for?
questions.explanation: DNS stands for Domain Name System, resolving domain names (like coalindia.in) to IP addresses.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which component in an OS manages hardware interrupts and system calls?
questions.explanation: The Kernel is the core component of an operating system, directly interacting with hardware and managing system calls.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the function of a Semaphore in concurrent programming?
options: Synchronization primitive used to control access to shared resources by multiple processes
questions.explanation: A semaphore is a variable used to control access to a common resource in a parallel programming environment.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In Python, which built-in data type is immutable?
questions.explanation: Tuples in Python are immutable sequences; their elements cannot be altered after creation.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the maximum number of edges in an undirected simple graph with 'n' vertices?
questions.explanation: Each of the n vertices can connect to (n-1) other vertices, halved because edges are undirected: n(n-1)/2.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In software engineering, what does the Agile manifesto prioritize over processes and tools?
questions.explanation: The Agile Manifesto values 'Individuals and interactions over processes and tools'.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which layer of the OSI model performs encryption and compression?
questions.explanation: The Presentation Layer (Layer 6) formats, encrypts, and compresses data for the application layer.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the worst-case time complexity of Merge Sort?
questions.explanation: Merge sort guarantees O(n log n) time complexity in all cases (worst, average, best).
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In SQL, which clause is used to filter records after aggregation (GROUP BY)?
questions.explanation: HAVING applies filter conditions to summarized group results produced by GROUP BY.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the main goal of Cyber Security 'Defense-in-Depth' strategy?
options: Rely on a single strong firewall
Layering multiple security mechanisms to protect data and assets
questions.explanation: Defense-in-depth uses multiple redundant security layers so if one fails, others continue protecting the system.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which type of memory is directly integrated inside the CPU chip to reduce latency?
questions.explanation: Cache memory (L1, L2, L3) resides directly on CPU silicon to provide high-speed data access.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the postfix expression for the infix expression: A + B * C ?
questions.explanation: Precedence gives B*C first (BC*), then addition with A yields A BC * +.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which IP address range is reserved for private local area networks (Class A private)?
questions.explanation: 10.0.0.0/8 is reserved by RFC 1918 as Class A private IP space.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the primary role of a Load Balancer in distributed systems?
options: Distributes incoming network traffic across multiple servers to ensure responsiveness
questions.explanation: Load balancers distribute traffic across server pools to optimize resource utilization and prevent server overload.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In Unix/Linux, which command changes file access permissions?
questions.explanation: chmod (change mode) modifies read, write, and execute permissions for user, group, and others.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What does COCOMO stand for in software estimation?
questions.explanation: COCOMO (Constructive Cost Model) is a procedural software cost estimation model developed by Barry Boehm.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which searching algorithm requires the input array to be sorted beforehand?
questions.explanation: Binary search compares the target value to the middle element of a sorted array.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the output of XOR gate when both inputs are 1?
questions.explanation: XOR output is 1 when inputs differ. When both inputs are 1 (equal), XOR output is 0.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the main drawback of a bus topology in local area networking?
options: A single break in the main backbone cable downs the entire network
questions.explanation: In bus topology, failure of the shared central bus cable disables communication across all connected nodes.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In relational algebra, which operator is represented by the Greek symbol Sigma (σ)?
questions.explanation: Sigma (σ) represents the Selection operator in relational algebra (filters rows satisfying a condition).
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which memory management scheme allows process physical address space to be non-contiguous?
questions.explanation: Paging divides memory into fixed-size pages and frames, allowing physical placement to be non-contiguous.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which protocol operates at the Application layer and is used to retrieve email from a server to a local client?
questions.explanation: POP3 and IMAP are used by clients to retrieve email messages from mail servers.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the space complexity of an adjacency matrix representation of a graph with V vertices?
questions.explanation: An adjacency matrix allocates a V × V 2D array, taking O(V^2) memory space regardless of edge count.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which technique is used by modern CPUs to execute multiple instructions simultaneously across different stages?
questions.explanation: Instruction pipelining breaks execution into sub-steps (Fetch, Decode, Execute, Writeback) for parallel processing.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the time complexity to insert a new element at the head of a Singly Linked List?
questions.explanation: Inserting at the head requires updating the new node's next pointer and head pointer, taking constant O(1) time.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What does SSL stand for in web communication?
questions.explanation: SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) and its successor TLS provide security and cryptographic encryption over web networks.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which indexing structure is commonly used by RDBMS databases to optimize range query lookups?
questions.explanation: B+ Trees keep data balanced and link leaf nodes together, enabling efficient sequential range queries in relational databases.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In Object-Oriented Software Design, what does the SOLID principles 'S' stand for?
questions.explanation: S in SOLID stands for Single Responsibility Principle: a class should have one, and only one, reason to change.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which error detection method uses polynomial division to detect transmission errors in data frames?
questions.explanation: CRC uses binary polynomial division to generate frame check sequences for detecting hardware transmission errors.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the minimum number of binary bits required to uniquely represent 50 distinct states?
questions.explanation: 5 bits = 2^5 = 32 states (insufficient). 6 bits = 2^6 = 64 states (sufficient to represent 50 states).
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which cloud computing model delivers raw virtual machines, storage, and networking resources on demand?
questions.explanation: IaaS (e.g. AWS EC2, Azure VMs) provides fundamental compute, storage, and networking infrastructure.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)
